assignment: Read-only proposal for copy-owned credential-free iOS simulator ad-hoc comparison; not an implemented or executed fix.
scope: No production/harness/source-freeze edits; original evidence preserved; root owns execution. IOS-R1 remains TEST/EVIDENCE GAP.
findings: Existing iOS cycle01 explicitly disables signing in env and CLI. Both app xcent candidates were absent; all four inventoried images lacked __entitlements/__ents_der; displayed launcher was linker-ad-hoc, Info.plist not bound, no resource seal. These observations do not diagnose historical user launch failures or prove a production entitlement defect.

Installed26.5SDK supplies application-identifier and default keychain-access-groups via SDK Entitlements.plist. App product defaults allow signing; raw simulator platform and SDK defaults differ, so raw defaults are not merged effective settings.

Installed CODE_SIGN_INJECT_BASE_ENTITLEMENTS defaultsYES. Apple official build-setting docs describe separate platform BaseEntitlements.plist injection. This setting must not be conflated with proof that SDK Entitlements.plist or effective keychain groups were generated.

Official Swift Build commit a155d53d5044ac6f442b318b93f550ed2ac38481 Provisioning.swift1–80 explicitly returns ad-hoc identity for simulator and selects SDK Entitlements.plist when required and no custom file; ProvisioningTaskInputs1–108 separates signed versus simulated entitlements. This is authoritative upstream counter-evidence to archived Simulator-unsigned prose, not byte-proven exact installed26.5 implementation.

Exact KGP2.4.10 XcodeEnvironment.sign reads nullable EXPANDED_CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY; empty is not absent. AppleXcodeTasks406–412 codesigns only embedded copied framework executable. Original build/bin or xcode-frameworks image hashes may therefore differ after signing while LC_UUID matches. Never treat UUID equality as cryptographic equality.
Normalizer only canonicalizes framework directory casing and verifies executable presence; no byte/plist changes. It must still run only after successful embed.

recommended_explicit_mode.status: PROPOSAL; not executed; factory/root independently review implementation before run
recommended_explicit_mode.applicable_only: Current-task copied wrapper, Debug configuration, iphonesimulator exact SDK, owned fresh simulator UUID and owned DerivedData; never iphoneos/Release/archive/export/upload or physical device.
recommended_explicit_mode.no_manual_entitlements: Keep SDK defaults for base injection, ENTITLEMENTS_REQUIRED, ENTITLEMENTS_DESTINATION and debug dylib layout. Do not force ENTITLEMENTS_ALLOWED=YES, manufacture TeamID/group/prefix, add a production entitlements file or weaken Keychain errors.
recommended_explicit_mode.credential_boundary: No -allowProvisioningUpdates or device registration; strict allowlist env; no real identity, keychain enumeration, credential path, profile, account/team, Store IDs or publishing. Keep exact known Debug ID; fail unexpected identity/profile values rather than fallback.
recommended_explicit_mode.phase_boundary: Require actual phase EXPANDED_CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY exactly dash in ad-hoc mode before Gradle (and no actual profile/team). Do not set blank or silently overwrite an unexpected Xcode value. Keep unsigned mode isolated with its original absent identity contract.
evidence_requirements: Capture allowlisted effective target settings including platform, SDK, configuration, bundle ID, required/allowed/ad-hoc/sign style/base entitlements and expanded identity; reject unintended targets or real profiles without reading private profile material.

Capture generated signed and simulated xcent shape plus bounded XML/__ents_der inventory of launcher/debug dylib/embedded framework/preview; capture final outer and nested signatures and bundle identity. Do not infer healthy storage from metadata.

Require actual current production synthetic Keychain add/read/update/delete and snapshot save/load/remove outcomes; distinguish operation failures/normal expected item-not-found from successful persistence. Reboot/relaunch path must reach intended screens and receipts.

Keep exact per-launch dyld path, in-memory UUID, root-owned on-disk SHA/UUID provenance. If XCTest loads different generated source image, identify that exact product separately; never claim installed bytes were loaded from UUID-only equality.

Retain original unsigned failure receipts; compare modes without changing application source/adding fallbackstorage or hiding errors. Archive compact native XCTest+parser receipts; execute only one build lane with immediate stop/precisecleanup on success/failure.
